key_features: RAG-powered healthcare search with confidence scoring
Conversational Ghanaian voice (no lists or bullet points)
First name only collection (never email or last name)
Automatic phone number usage from VAPI webhook
No-hallucination policy with tool result grounding
Medical disclaimers on all health advice

confidence_handling.requires_escalation_flag: true - Always escalate regardless of score

testing_checklist: Test: 'Find me doctors in Madina' (should use RAG tool)
Test: 'Emergency hospitals in Accra' (should use RAG tool)
Test: Unknown location query (should trigger low confidence escalation)
Test: Request to send details (should use SMS)
Test: Book appointment (should use calendar tools)
Verify: Confidence scores in RAG responses
Verify: No lists or bullet points in responses
notes: Tool count reduced from 19 to 6 (68% reduction)
RAG tool replaces 5 deprecated structured search tools
Cleaner, more focused tool set for better LLM decision making
System prompt emphasizes RAG tool for ALL healthcare queries
